# Domain Rules

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Overview

- **Conversation / Message**: user ↔ assistant exchange; assistant replies streamed, typed by `result_type`.
- **Intent routing**: each user message → `direct_answer | use_tool | delegate_agent | long_task`.
- **AI model selection**: per conversation/agent/default, with fallback chain and monthly cost cap.
- **Agent**: catalogue persona with own model, tools, delegation depth, tool-call limit, timeout.
- **Tool**: catalogue entry (`internal | mcp | rest | webhook`), JSON Schema in/out, `is_write` / `is_sensitive` gates.
- **Approval**: owner decision gating write/sensitive tools; expires.
- **Task**: background agent run on `tasks` queue with steps, logs, progress, cancel/retry.
- **Memory**: per-user long-term facts with pgvector embedding; `confirmed` or `hypothesis`.
- **Connector**: MCP server (global or personal) with discovered tools and health status.
- **Settings**: global runtime tunables (`settings` table).

### Intent routing

Implemented in `app/Services/IntentRouter.php` (bound to `MessageRouter` in `AppServiceProvider`).

1. `@slug rest` prefix (regex `^@([a-z0-9-]+)(?:\s+(.+))?$`) → intent `delegate_agent`, confidence `1.0`, prefix stripped. Unknown slug → default agent (`is_default`) → `personal-assistant`.
2. Else `IntentClassifier` (structured output, default text model) returns `intent`, `agent_slug`, `confidence`.
3. Any classifier failure (no default model, provider error, invalid intent) → keyword heuristics, confidence `0.5`, `model: null`.
4. Non-direct intent: suggested agent if active, else default agent; no agent available → falls back to direct answer.
5. Decision stored at `messages.meta.routing = {intent, agent, confidence, model}`.
6. `direct_answer` → `BrainClient` with `DirectAnswerRouter::MEMORY_INSTRUCTIONS`; all others → `AgentRunner` synchronously inside `ProcessUserMessage` (`long_task` included; `TaskService::createFromMessage` has no caller in `app/`).

Keyword heuristics (first match wins, case-insensitive substring):

| Keyword (pt-BR) | Intent | Agent |
|---|---|---|
| `relatório`, `levantamento`, `auditoria`, `pesquisa aprofundada`, `análise aprofundada`, `tarefa longa` | `long_task` | `research` |
| `lembre que`, `guarde que`, `que horas`, `hora atual`, `data atual` | `use_tool` | `personal-assistant` |
| `escreva código`, `revise o código` | `delegate_agent` | `developer` |
| `automatize` | `delegate_agent` | `automation` |
| `redija` | `delegate_agent` | `communication` |
| `pesquise` | `delegate_agent` | `research` |
| no match | `direct_answer` | — |

Extend: append `['keyword' => ..., 'intent' => self::..., 'agent' => '<seeded slug>']` to `IntentRouter::HEURISTICS`; order matters.

### Model selection precedence

`app/Services/ModelSelector.php`:

| Order | Source | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `conversations.ai_model_id` | model active, has `text` capability, provider active |
| 2 | `agents.ai_model_id` | same |
| 3 | `ai_models.is_default_text = true` | same; none → `NoModelAvailableException` |

- Embeddings: model with `is_default_embedding = true`, active, active provider.
- Partial unique indexes allow only 1 default text and 1 default embedding model (`ai_models` migration).

### Fallback chain

`app/Services/FallbackChain.php` + `BrainClient::stream`:

- Chain = primary (if usable) + active text models with `fallback_order` (ascending), primary not repeated.
- Each attempt: cost check → stream → usage row (`completed` or failure status). Failure → next model.
- Chain exhausted → `AllProvidersFailedException`; reply saved `failed` with `meta.error = all_providers_failed`.
- AI jobs never retry (`$tries = 1` in `ProcessUserMessage`, `RunTask`, `ExtractMemoryHypotheses`, `GenerateConversationTitle`).

### Monthly cost limit

`app/Services/CostLimitGuard.php`:

- `users.monthly_cost_limit` null → never blocked.
- Spent = `SUM(usage_records.estimated_cost)` since start of month; spent > limit → `UsageLimitExceededException`.
- First breach per month creates `usage_limit_reached` notification; repeats suppressed.
- HTTP entry: message POST → `402`. In-job: reply `failed`, `meta.error = usage_limit_exceeded`.

### Tool execution gate

`app/Tools/ToolExecutor.php`, order of checks:

1. Tool inactive → `ToolNotAuthorizedException`.
2. Agent run carries call → tool must be attached via `agent_tool`, else `ToolNotAuthorizedException`.
3. `is_write || is_sensitive` without approval → `ApprovalService::request()`, tool does NOT run (`ToolResult::pendingApproval`).
4. Carried approval: pending → marked approved; expired/denied → blocked.
5. Input validated against `tools.input_schema` (`JsonSchemaValidator`); errors → `failed` execution + `ToolInputInvalidException`.
6. Run by type: `internal` (handler class or `InternalToolRegistry`), `rest|webhook` (`HttpToolHandler`), `mcp` (`McpToolHandler`).
7. Timeout: `tools.timeout_seconds` or `brain.tool_timeout_seconds` (default 30); `pcntl_alarm` when available → `timed_out`.
8. Output validated against `output_schema`; mismatch → `failed`.
9. Every run recorded in `tool_executions`; broadcasts `tool.started|completed|failed`; write tools audited `tool_executed` with `approval_id`, `approved_by`.

- New catalogue rows default `is_write = true`, `is_sensitive = true` (migration `create_tools_table`).

### Approval lifecycle

`app/Services/ApprovalService.php`, statuses `pending → approved | denied | expired`:

| Action | Guard | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| request | — | row `pending`, `expires_at = now + brain.approval_ttl_hours` (default 24); task → `waiting_approval`; state `EXECUTING`; `approval_pending` notification; chat message `payload.type = approval_request` |
| approve | owner only (403), pending only (409), not expired (409) | `approved`, audit `approval_approved`, task → `running` + `RunTask` re-dispatched with `resumeFromStep`; listener `ExecuteApprovedTool` runs tool once |
| deny | same guards | `denied` + `decision_reason` (≤500), audit `approval_denied`, task resumes knowing denial |
| expire | `jarvis:approvals:expire` every minute | `expired`, audit `approval_expired`, treated as denial |

### Agent delegation guards

`app/Services/DelegationService.php` — checked in order; violations return `UntrustedContent::wrapJson(['error' => ...])` to the parent instead of throwing:

| Guard | Rule |
|---|---|
| Parent run | delegation requires a parent `agent_execution` |
| Target active | inactive target blocked |
| Depth | `parent.depth + 1 ≤ min(origin.max_delegation_depth, brain.max_delegation_depth)` (default 3, range 0–5) |
| Cycle | target ≠ origin and not in `ancestorAgentIds()` |
| Time | parent `started_at + origin.timeout_seconds` still in future (0 = unlimited) |

- Delegation tools are catalogue rows `delegate.<slug>`, synced by `jarvis:agents:sync-delegation` (`syncTools()`); inactive/trashed agents deactivate their row.
- `RuntimeAgent::maxSteps()` = `max(1, toolCallLimit) + 2` (one step per allowed call, final answer, 1 extra so an over-limit call surfaces) — `app/Ai/Agents/RuntimeAgent.php`.
- Tool names sent to providers pass `ToolName::forProvider()`: chars outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]` → `_`, >64 chars truncated + hash suffix (`delegate.research` → `delegate_research`) — `app/Support/ToolName.php`.
- `AgentRunner`: tool calls > `toolCallLimit` → execution `failed` (`ToolCallLimitExceededException`); runtime errors return `failed`/`timed_out` executions; only inactive agent throws `AgentUnavailableException`.

### Task state machine

`app/Services/TaskService.php`, `app/Jobs/RunTask.php`, `app/Models/Task.php`:

```
pending -> queued -> running -> completed
                       |  ^
                       v  |  (approval decided -> RunTask(resumeFromStep))
               waiting_approval
running -> failed      (error or worker timeout; RunTask::failed)
queued|running|waiting_approval -> cancelled
failed --retry--> new task (retry_of_task_id) -> pending -> queued
```

- Entry: `TaskService::queue()` is reached only from `retry()`; `createFromMessage()` has no caller in `app/`, so chat never creates tasks. Resume dispatch comes from `ApprovalService::resumeTask()`.
- Terminal: `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` (`Task::TERMINAL_STATUSES`).
- Cancel: Redis flag `task:{id}:cancel_requested` (TTL 1 day); job checks before each step; pending approvals of the task denied with reason `tarefa cancelada`. Non-cancellable → `409`.
- Retry: only `failed`; non-retryable → `409`; response `201`.
- Resume prompt prefixes finished step names; finished steps never repeated.
- Timeout: `tasks.timeout_seconds` (default `brain.task_timeout_seconds` 900); worker `--timeout=960`. Timeout errors surface as `error = "timeout"`.
- Progress broadcasts throttled to 1 `task.updated` per 500 ms per task.
- Outcome notifications: `task_completed` / `task_failed`.

### Memory

`app/Services/MemoryService.php`, `MemoryRetriever.php`, `SensitiveDataDetector.php`:

- Sensitive content rejected (`SensitiveMemoryRejectedException`) unless `explicit = true`. Detector: CPF `\d{3}\.?\d{3}\.?\d{3}-?\d{2}`, 13–19 digit card numbers, `senha|password|passwd` followed by `:`/`=`, `sk-…` API keys, 19 health terms.
- Dedupe: cosine similarity ≥ `memory.duplicate_threshold` (default 0.92) with an existing memory of the same user → update that row; `confirmed` beats `hypothesis`.
- Retrieval: only owner's `confirmed` memories, similarity ≥ `memory.similarity_threshold` (0.75), top `memory.top_n` (5); stamps `last_used_at`.
- Edit regenerates embedding; delete/discard = hard delete of memory + embedding, audit `memory_deleted`.
- Hypotheses proposed post-reply by `ExtractMemoryHypotheses` (queue `low`); confirm → `confirmed_at`.
- Categories: `preference`, `project`, `context`, `learning`, `fact`.

### Structured results

`app/Results/ResultNormalizer.php`, `app/Services/StructuredResultExtractor.php`:

- Extraction runs when tools were used, content has a markdown table, or ≥3 list lines.
- Types: `text`, `list`, `table`, `report`, `search_results`, `task_card`, `data`, `execution_status`, `document` — schemas in `resources/schemas/results/*.json`.
- Invalid payload → `{type: "text", text, meta: {result_invalid: true}}`.

### Connectors (MCP)

`app/Services/ConnectorService.php`, `ConnectorStatusService.php`, `app/Support/McpUrlValidator.php`, `app/Models/McpServer.php`:

- URL must be `http(s)://` with host; private/loopback/reserved hosts rejected unless `MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS`.
- Scope: `user_id` null = global (admin-managed, read-only to users → 403 on edit); else personal.
- Status `pending | connected | error | disconnected`; transition broadcasts `connector.status.changed`; entering `error` notifies audience (`connector_error`).
- Health check every minute, per-connector interval `connector.health_check_minutes` (default 5); tool discovery via `SyncMcpServerTools`. Tools no longer on the server (`is_available = false`) cannot be activated (422).

### Rate limits

`app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`:

| Limiter | Limit | Key |
|---|---|---|
| `api` (global) | 120/min | user id or IP |
| `login` | 5/min | lowercased email + IP |
| `messages` | `brain.messages_per_minute` (default 60)/min | user id |
| `approvals` | 30/min | user id |
| `connectors.resync` | 6/min | connector id |

- 429 body `{message, retry_after}` + `Retry-After` header (`bootstrap/app.php`).

### Retention

`jarvis:retention:prune` daily (`app/Console/Commands/PruneRetention.php`, `--dry-run`):

| Data | Setting | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `tool_executions` | `retention.tool_executions_days` | 90 days |
| `task_logs` | `retention.task_logs_days` | 90 days |
| `usage_records` | `retention.usage_records_months` | 24 months |
| read `notifications` | `retention.read_notifications_days` | 30 days |
